question: With one ready aircraft deployed against the accepted A03 mission's NOS=MNOS=2, does the native model call and wait or immediately reject the wave, and does it prevent a one-aircraft launch through the h8 plus one-third-hour delay deadline?

accepted_parent.accepted_behavior: Two ready physical aircraft of one type meet NOS=MNOS=2, jointly launch the sole h8 scheduled wave, succeed and complete at h10, and yield four aircraft flight-hours; 11 original native raw files are locally sealed.

instructional_prerequisite.behavior_scope: published fixed scheduled mission and repeated-wave baseline

manual.interpretation: For quantity-based assignment, MissionType.MNOS is the minimum required to start and NOS the nominal target. A mission below minimum can remain called while waiting for systems until the latest allowable start; it cannot launch with fewer than MNOS. The manual does not decide whether this one-of-two source temporarily allocates its sole aircraft or the exact native cancellation timestamp.

source_delta.only_changed_cell: SystemDeployment row0 QTYPS 2 to 1; preserve MissionType.NOS=MNOS=2, fixed h8 wave, DTIM one-third hour, one aircraft type/unit, seed, 36-hour horizon, collection interval 0.5 and all other authored cells
source_delta.negative_control: accepted A03 parent jointly launches two aircraft at h8 and completes at h10; no accepted run is repeated

predeclared_acceptance: Independent contract review must pin accepted A03 input, contract, signoff, independent review, closure and all 11 local raw files, plus the published A02 prerequisite; do not rerun the parent.

Freeze exact positional one-cell parent diff, independent negative control, authored-table roundtrip checker, strict source/raw/event/report validator, unique SSH0 runner and separately reviewed prelaunch GO bound to their SHA values before native.

Require actual SSH0/sshd ancestry, free Global\SimloxIssue18NativeQueue, absent unique run directory, exact responding GUI PID/session/start, stable source SHA before/after and preserved failure bytes.
Import/export must retain QTYPS=1 and unchanged NOS=MNOS=2. Converter errors zero and classified warnings are mandatory; rejection or missing report is NO_GO for physical behavior.

Predeclare two acceptable assignment traces: the sole aircraft may be temporarily assigned or left ready while the mission waits. In either trace, zero mission launches, sorties, successes and completions are required. A cancellation or mission wait timeout must be identified by mission ID at or before the h8+one-third-hour delay deadline, with no second physical aircraft. If temporarily assigned, this deliberately strict bounded test also requires an ID-specific System arrives release event at the cancellation timestamp within 0.0001 hour; the manual does not guarantee that event, and its absence is NO_GO even if terminal readiness appears. If native semantics differ, retain all evidence rather than relaxing the gate.

Require complete 72x40 System, 72x16 Stock, 11 ResultSummary and ProblemDescription field reconciliation using the actual predeclared assignment trace, zero flight aircraft-hours, zero stock movement, and one terminal ready aircraft; no summary-only acceptance.

Require separately authored read-only replay of every source/raw SHA and size, exact source delta, event identity/order and all report fields, bounded signoff, independent staged and remote review, and authorized simlox/main PR/merge.
limits: One seed, type, unit and scheduled wave with one available of two required aircraft only; no zero-available, exactly-minimum alternative, mixed types, fault/PM, GUI, cross-engine, performance or full A03.var01 claim.
K01/K08 GUI capture and K06 remain blocked; I07 opening-stock-three and E05.var02 exact-time remain excluded; Issue18 remains unfinished.
